paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of context masking on case tasks groupby by language family. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family, for various models. The horizontal axis represents the language families, which are listed in the following order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indo-European, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic; the vertical axis represents the effect, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30. Each language family has six bars, representing the models mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, with distinct colors. The approximate values for the shortest and tallest bars are 1 and 23, respectively. The bars for IE-Indo-European, specifically for models XLM-R2 and mBERT-B2, appear to be the tallest among all language families. Error bars are included to indicate the standard deviation for each data point. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart presents a grouped representation, with each group consisting of six bars corresponding to the six models, allowing for a visual comparison of the effect across different language families and models.
